name: test_enemy_cucumber

name: test_bg_livingroom
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game battlefield background, portrait 9:16
Scene: top-down (bird's-eye, camera looking straight down with a very slight tilt) view of a cosy living-room floor at golden hour. In the centre is a large rectangular soft cream-and-teal rug taking about 60% of the width, with a subtle woven pattern and tasselled short edges. Around the rug runs a clear warm wooden plank floor forming a continuous rectangular walkway (a loop path) of even width on all four sides. Outside the walkway at the far edges: glimpses of a sofa edge, a potted plant, a cat scratching post, a toy mouse, a yarn ball, a food bowl, warm sunlight patches from a window.
Style: 2D cartoon mobile game art, clean shapes, soft cel shading, warm vibrant colours, slightly desaturated so characters placed on top stand out, no heavy outlines on the floor.
Composition: perfectly symmetrical layout, rug centred, walkway unobstructed and empty, nothing overlapping the rug or the walkway.
Constraints: no characters, no animals, no text, no UI, no watermark.
